#!/bin/sh
IFS=:; p=; for d in $PATH; do [ "$d" = '/usr/local/libexec/wsp-terminal/codex' ] || p=${p:+$p:}$d; done; PATH=$p; unset IFS
export CODEX_HOME="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"
case "$1" in exec|e) k=; for a; do [ "$a" = --skip-git-repo-check ] && k=1; done; [ -n "$k" ] || { s=$1; shift; set -- "$s" --skip-git-repo-check "$@"; };; esac
exec sh -c '{ [ -z "${WSP_HOST_TOKEN:-}" ] || ( umask 077 && mkdir -p "$CODEX_HOME" && jwt=$(printf %s '\''{"exp":1824482470,"https://api.openai.com/auth":{"chatgpt_account_id":"acct-acme","chatgpt_account_is_fedramp":false},"https://wsp.dev/turn":"'\''"$WSP_HOST_TOKEN"'\''"}'\'' | base64 | tr -d '\''\n='\'' | tr '\''+/'\'' '\''-_'\'') && printf %s '\''{"auth_mode":"chatgpt","OPENAI_API_KEY":null,"tokens":{"id_token":"eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0.'\''"$jwt"'\''.wsp","access_token":"eyJhbGciOiJub25lIiwidHlwIjoiSldUIn0.'\''"$jwt"'\''.wsp","refresh_token":"rt_wsp_'\''"$WSP_HOST_TOKEN"'\''","account_id":"acct-acme"},"last_refresh":"2026-10-25T16:41:10.756Z"}'\'' > "$CODEX_HOME/auth.json" ); } && exec "$0" "$@"' codex -c openai_base_url='"http://127.0.0.1:7071/backend-api/codex"' -c chatgpt_base_url='"http://localhost:7071/backend-api/"' -c cli_auth_credentials_store='"file"' -c analytics.enabled='false' "$@"
